'''Tag Raynor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Clog-dweller]]. He offered to sell the [[Black Sphere]] to a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] by arranging a meet in the [[Gold Plaza]]. He was however an employee of [[Hahz Fallone]] and was merely setting them up so [[Jorga Sune]] would try and get the artifact which was a fake. During the exchange he was killed by [[Falad Prok]] who shot him with a [[Poison/Legends|poison]] [[Dart shooter|dart pistol]].
